subtitle: How the Great Wrestler Turned His Father’s Defeat into Vatapi’s Fall

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of a young king on a war elephant before a vast army
panels.action: Narasimhavarman I Mamalla stands tall on a caparisoned elephant, hand on spear, Pallava banners rippling behind him as rocky Deccan hills fade into a stormy horizon.

dialogue.text: In the age when Pallava and Chalukya spears crossed over the Deccan, Narasimhavarman Mamalla rose from his father’s defeat to carry Kanchi’s standard to Vatapi.

i18n.hi: जब पल्लव और चालुक्य भाले दक्कन पर टकराते थे, नरसिंहवर्मन ममल्ला पिता की हार से उठकर कांची का ध्वज वातापी तक ले गया।

panels.shot: somber mid-shot inside a palace hall, with carved pillars and shadowed courtiers
panels.action: A younger Narasimhavarman Mamalla, still prince, stands beside a seated Mahendravarman’s empty throne, fists clenched, as ministers bow in uneasy silence beneath painted battle murals.

dialogue.text: Mahendravarman had tasted Pulakeshin’s advance and checked it near Kanchi, but the wound of defeat remained. Into that hall of memory stepped his son, Narasimhavarman, bearing a heavier crown.

i18n.hi: महेंद्रवर्मन ने पुलकेशिन की चढ़ाई को कांची के पास रोक तो दिया, पर हार का घाव रह गया। उसी यादों के सभा में भारी मुकुट लेकर कदम रखा उसके बेटे नरसिंहवर्मन ने।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Mamalla’s face, half in light, half in shadow
panels.action: Close on Mamalla’s determined face as he looks toward a mural showing Chalukya warriors pressing south, his jaw set, eyes bright with controlled anger and resolve.

dialogue.text: The Chalukya king Pulakeshin II had once boasted of carrying his banner deep into Pallava lands. The son who heard that boast swore that one day Vatapi would hear a different song.

i18n.hi: चालुक्य राजा पुलकेशिन द्वितीय कभी डींग मारता था कि उसका ध्वज पल्लव भूमि में गहराई तक गया है। वह बेटा जिसने वह घमंड सुना, मन में ठान चुका था कि एक दिन वातापी में दूसरी धुन बजेगी।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye over Kanchipuram’s bustling streets and sacred compounds
panels.action: A high view of Kanchipuram’s crowded markets, temple gopurams and monastic complexes, with Mamalla riding through the streets on horseback as monks, Brahmins and traders watch.

dialogue.text: Around 640, the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang walked through Mamalla’s Kanchipuram and saw a city rich in monasteries, temples and learning. Peace here was not weakness, but treasure to guard.

i18n.hi: लगभग ६४० में चीनी यात्री श्वेनज़ांग ममल्ला के कांचीपुरम में चला और विहारों, मंदिरों और विद्या से भरा नगर देखा। यहाँ की शांति कमजोरी नहीं, पहरी जाने वाली दौलत थी।

panels.shot: wide interior shot of a council chamber with maps and palm-leaf documents
panels.action: Mamalla leans over a floor map showing the Deccan plateau, rivers and routes to Vatapi, while generals and ministers sit around, palm-leaf grants and copper plates stacked nearby.

dialogue.text: Yet in the copper-plates and halls of counsel, another story was taking shape: the Pallava king would not merely protect Kanchi’s wealth; he would answer the northern power in its own capital.

i18n.hi: पर ताम्रपत्रों और मंत्रणा के हॉल में दूसरी कथा बन रही थी: पल्लव राजा सिर्फ कांची की समृद्धि नहीं बचाएगा, वह उत्तरी शक्ति को उसके ही राजधानी में जवाब देगा।

panels.shot: dynamic battlefield wide near Manimangalam, dust and formations visible
panels.action: On an open plain lined with palm groves, Mamalla on horseback points forward as Pallava infantry and cavalry move against approaching Chalukya formations under a hazy sky.

dialogue.text: The clash came near Kanchi and at Manimangalam. Narasimhavarman met Chalukya forces on familiar soil, fighting not as a rash avenger but as a patient wrestler testing each hold.

i18n.hi: टकराव कांची के पास और मणिमंगला में हुआ। नरसिंहवर्मन ने चालुक्य सेना से अपने परिचित मैदान पर टक्कर ली, जोशीले बदले की तरह नहीं, धीरज वाले पहलवान की तरह हर पकड़ आज़मा कर।

panels.shot: low-angle shot through dust as Chalukya troops retreat in the distance
panels.action: Dust hangs in the air as Mamalla sits steady on his horse in the foreground, watching broken Chalukya lines pull back across the plain, Pallava standards holding firm.

dialogue.text: The Kuram grant later spoke of Pulakeshin’s forces driven back and of Pallava victory. The field did not end the war, but it showed that Mahendravarman’s son could withstand the thunder from Vatapi.

i18n.hi: कुरम की ताम्रपत्र बाद में बताएंगे कि पुलकेशिन की सेना पीछे धकेली गई और पल्लवों की जीत हुई। यह मैदान युद्ध का अंत नहीं था, पर दिखा गया कि महेंद्रवर्मन का बेटा वातापी की गरज झेल सकता है।

panels.shot: intimate mid-shot in a temple mandapa, lamplight flickering on stone
panels.action: Inside a stone mandapa, Mamalla kneels before a Shiva linga, a single oil lamp burning, while a trusted general stands respectfully behind, waiting for his king’s word.

dialogue.speaker: narasimhavarman_i_mamalla
dialogue.text: We have answered their advance. Now we must answer their pride.

i18n.hi: उनकी चढ़ाई का जवाब दे दिया है। अब उनके घमंड का जवाब देना होगा।

panels.shot: strategic mid-shot of Mamalla briefing Paranjothi and officers in camp
panels.action: In a war camp with tents and stacked spears, Mamalla speaks to Paranjothi and assembled commanders, pointing from a palm-leaf map toward the stylized hills marking Vatapi.

dialogue.text: When his chance came, Narasimhavarman sent his general Paranjothi north. The goal was not another border skirmish, but the Chalukya capital itself: Vatapi, the rocky fortress of Pulakeshin’s line.

i18n.hi: मौका मिलते ही नरसिंहवर्मन ने अपने सेनापति परंजोति को उत्तर की ओर भेजा। लक्ष्य सिर्फ सीमा पर झड़प नहीं, चालुक्य राजधानी थी: वातापी, पुलकेशिन वंश का पथरीला दुर्ग।

panels.shot: epic wide of the Pallava host marching across the Deccan plateau
panels.action: A long column of Pallava soldiers, elephants and horses moves across undulating Deccan terrain, with Mamalla riding near the front, the horizon stretching toward distant hills.

dialogue.text: The march to Vatapi was long. Each ridge and river crossing carried Pallava strength deep into the plateau that had once supplied the king who troubled Kanchi’s doors.

i18n.hi: वातापी की ओर कूच लंबा था। हर घाट, हर नदी पार करते हुए पल्लव बल उस पठार में घुसता गया, जहाँ से कभी वह राजा आया था जिसने कांची के द्वारों को सताया था।

panels.shot: dramatic reveal wide of Vatapi’s hill-side city and fortifications
panels.action: From a vantage ridge, Mamalla and his officers gaze upon Vatapi, its stone walls hugging the red hills, temples and houses scattered below in the basin.

dialogue.text: Around 642, Pallava troops reached Vatapi. The Kuram inscription would later remember this moment starkly: the northern stronghold was taken, its pride bent under a southern king’s campaign.

i18n.hi: लगभग ६४२ में पल्लव सैनिक वातापी पहुँच गए। कुरम शिलालेख ने बाद में इस घड़ी को साफ शब्दों में याद किया: उत्तरी गढ़ जीत लिया गया, उसका घमंड दक्षिणी राजा की मुहिम के आगे झुक गया।

panels.shot: tense mid-shot at the foot of Vatapi’s walls, soldiers poised for assault
panels.action: At the base of Vatapi’s fortress walls, ladders and siege gear lie ready while Mamalla, armored, confers calmly with his captains, the rocky gate towering over them.

dialogue.text: How exactly the walls were breached the records do not say. They speak only of victory, not of miracle, duel or single stroke. In history, Vatapi fell to planning, persistence and the strain of war.

i18n.hi: दीवारें कैसे टूटीं, अभिलेख नहीं बताते। वे बस जीत की कहते हैं, न किसी चमत्कार, न एकल द्वंद्व, न एक ही वार की। इतिहास में वातापी योजना, धीरज और युद्ध की थकान से गिरा।

panels.shot: somber interior wide of Vatapi’s royal quarter under occupation
panels.action: Inside Vatapi’s royal quarter, Mamalla walks through courtyards now guarded by Pallava soldiers, local officials bowing with guarded expressions as the conqueror surveys the halls.

dialogue.text: After the storm, a quieter reality settled on Vatapi. For a season, the Pallava lion held the Chalukya den, and the old boast of southern weakness rang hollow in its own streets.

i18n.hi: तूफ़ान के बाद वातापी पर ठहरी हुई सचाई छा गई। कुछ समय के लिए पल्लव सिंह ने चालुक्य मांद संभाली, और दक्षिण की कमजोरी वाली पुरानी डींग उसी की गलियों में बेअसर हो गई।

panels.shot: reflective mid-shot of Mamalla overlooking Vatapi’s temples at dusk
panels.action: At dusk, Mamalla stands on a hill ledge, looking down at Vatapi’s temples and houses, the sky burning orange as his cloak stirs in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: narasimhavarman_i_mamalla
dialogue.text: Father, your defeat gave me this resolve. May I honor its cost.

i18n.hi: पिता, तुम्हारी हार ने मुझे यह संकल्प दिया। मैं उसकी कीमत का सम्मान करूँ।

panels.shot: wide shot of a shrine or inscription being commissioned in Pallava style
panels.action: Mamalla instructs artisans and scribes near a newly built stone shrine, a copper-plate grant held by a priest, as they carve and record Pallava victories for posterity.

dialogue.text: Back in Pallava lands, copper-plates like the Kuram grant gave the campaign a clear shape: Pulakeshin’s line checked, Vatapi humbled, Narasimhavarman named among kings who reshaped the South.

i18n.hi: पल्लव भूमि में लौटकर कुरम जैसी ताम्रपत्रों ने मुहिम को स्पष्ट रूप दिया: पुलकेशिन का वंश रोका गया, वातापी नम हुआ, नरसिंहवर्मन उन राजाओं में गिना गया जिन्होंने दक्षिण का नक्शा बदला।

panels.shot: subtle close-up of Mamalla reading a report, brows furrowed
panels.action: Mamalla sits in his palace, studying a palm-leaf dispatch by lamplight, his brow tightened, suggesting news from the Deccan as Chalukya power begins to recover.

dialogue.text: The Chalukya epigraphic voice falls silent after 642, then speaks again in later years. Evidence suggests a time of crisis and recovery, and that Pallava control of Vatapi did not last beyond the mid-century.

i18n.hi: चालुक्य लेखों की आवाज ६४२ के बाद थम जाती है और फिर बाद के वर्षों में बोलती है। प्रमाण संकट और संभलने की घड़ी दिखाते हैं, और कि पल्लवों का वातापी पर अधिकार मध्य शताब्दी से आगे नहीं चला।

panels.shot: expansive wide of Kanchipuram with temples and monks, Mamalla in foreground
panels.action: On a rooftop in Kanchi, Mamalla watches monks, Brahmins and townsfolk move between Buddhist viharas and Hindu temples, gopurams rising over the prosperous city.

dialogue.text: Xuanzang’s visit anchors Mamalla’s reign in a different light: beyond war, Kanchipuram flourished as a center of learning and devotion, even as its king’s name traveled with armies and grants.

i18n.hi: श्वेनज़ांग की यात्रा ममल्ला के शासन को अलग रोशनी देती है: युद्ध के पार, कांचीपुरम विद्या और भक्ति का केंद्र बनकर खिलता रहा, जबकि उसके राजा का नाम सेनाओं और दानपत्रों के साथ दूर जाता रहा।

panels.shot: quiet mid-shot of Mamalla listening to a poet or priest reciting
panels.action: Mamalla sits relaxed as a court poet recites, hands raised, before an audience of courtiers, the words evoking battles and journeys while a sculpted wrestling motif decorates the hall.

dialogue.text: Stories of Vatapi’s fall grew around his feat. Later tradition wrapped it in miracle and saintly power, but the stone and copper remember a king and his general using war’s harsh logic with measured resolve.

i18n.hi: वातापी के पतन की कथाएँ उसकी उपलब्धि के चारों ओर उग आईं। बाद की परंपरा ने इसे चमत्कार और संतों की शक्ति से सजाया, पर पत्थर और ताम्रपत्र एक राजा और उसके सेनापति को याद रखते हैं जो युद्ध की सख्त तर्क को नपा-तुला चला रहे थे।

panels.shot: final heroic low-angle of Mamalla beside the sea at Mahabalipuram
panels.action: Mamalla stands on a rocky shore near unfinished rock-cut temples, waves crashing below, as sculptors chip at stone, tying his image to enduring monuments and the vast horizon.

dialogue.text: Narasimhavarman Mamalla turned a father’s setback into strength and carried it north until Vatapi bowed. His legacy endures where patience waits for its hour and then strikes with clear, remembered purpose.

i18n.hi: नरसिंहवर्मन ममल्ला ने पिता की ठोकर को ताकत में बदल दिया और उसे उत्तर तक ले गए, जब तक कि वातापी झुक न गया। उसकी विरासत वहाँ जीवित है जहाँ धीरज अपना समय देखकर, साफ इरादे से वार करता है।

subtitle_i18n.en: How the Great Wrestler Turned His Father’s Defeat into Vatapi’s Fall
subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे महान पहलवान ने पिता की हार को वातापी के पतन में बदला
